requirements.summary: Wire the 'Create New Comment List' section's 'Create' button to call the backend create function with the entered list ID from the input field
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Create' button triggers backend API call with input value
Input field is cleared after successful creation
Success toast notification displays 'Comment list created successfully'
Error toast displays if creation fails (e.g., duplicate ID)
Comment list dropdown in 'Manage Comments' section updates to include the new list

file_operations.description: Add a new React Query mutation hook 'useCreateCommentList' that calls actor.createCommentList(listId) and invalidates the 'availableCommentLists' query cache on success. Follow the existing pattern used by other mutation hooks in this file (e.g., useAddSingleComment). Include error handling for duplicate list IDs and other backend failures.

Import and use the new 'useCreateCommentList' hook. Wire the 'Create' button onClick handler to call the mutation with the input field value. On success, clear the input field and show a success toast ('Comment list created successfully'). On error, display an error toast with the backend error message. The component already has toast functionality and input state management; extend the existing 'Create New Comment List' section handlers to integrate the new mutation.

requirements.summary: Display loading state on the 'Create' button while the backend request is in progress, and disable the button during submission to prevent duplicate requests
acceptanceCriteria: Button shows loading spinner or 'Creating...' text during API call
Button is disabled while request is in flight
Button returns to normal 'Create' state after completion

file_operations.description: Use the 'isPending' or 'isLoading' state from the useCreateCommentList mutation hook to conditionally disable the 'Create' button and update its display text. When isPending is true, set the button disabled attribute and change the button text from 'Create' to 'Creating...' or render a loading spinner icon. Follow the existing button loading pattern used elsewhere in the component (e.g., 'Add Comments' button).

requirements.summary: Validate that the list ID input field is not empty before allowing submission, displaying an error message if the user attempts to create a list without entering an ID
acceptanceCriteria: Empty input field prevents form submission
User sees validation error message: 'Please enter a list ID'
Button remains enabled but validation prevents API call

file_operations.description: Add client-side validation in the 'Create' button onClick handler. Before calling the createCommentList mutation, check if the input field value is empty or whitespace-only. If empty, display an error toast with the message 'Please enter a list ID' and return early without calling the backend. This validation runs before the mutation is invoked, keeping the button enabled but preventing the API call.
